name: Generic webhook
summary: POST a JSON message from Ogun to any HTTPS endpoint you name, optionally signed with an HMAC so the receiver can check where it came from.

fields.name: signing_secret
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Shared with the receiver; used to sign, never sent. Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Host
settings.help: Host name of the receiver, without https://.

settings.name: path
settings.label: Path
settings.help: Shown in approvals. Keep tokens out of it.

egress.note: The host you set, on the port you set. HTTPS only.

operators.summary: POST a JSON message to the HTTPS endpoint, with an X-Ogun-Signature header when a signing secret is set.

notes: HTTPS only. With a signing secret, each request carries an X-Ogun-Signature header, an HMAC of the request body, for the receiver to check. The secret itself is never sent. The path is a plain setting and appears in approvals; if the receiver hands you a URL with a token in it, that URL is a secret.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
